hook_text: A crane on one bench, a shelter sketch on the other, and one process running under both. Here is the second half of the year in a minute.
clip_script: Shelf one, term three, all hanging on the crane. Magnets: two poles, only ferrous metals stick. Circuits: a closed loop with the right symbols. Electromagnet: coil, iron core, switch it off. Crank: second-class lever. Pulley: wheel and axle for rope. Advantage: load over effort, paid in distance. Oblique at 45 degrees; flow charts with diamonds. Shelf two, term four, people and food and cloth. Shelter, water, toilets, food, in that order. Twenty litres, 2 100 kilocalories, 3.5 square metres. Five questions for camp food; processing makes it pass. Textiles: hazard first, cotton burns, polyester melts, aramids do not, build in layers. Shelf three, the shelter. Four disasters. Six people, a month, sturdy, waterproof, up in an hour. Vents, spacing, a stove place. Borrow the dome, not the thatch. Test the fabric, seal the seams, write ten lines, sketch two shapes. Under it all: investigate, design, make, evaluate, communicate.
visual_style: Whiteboard three shelves filling with icons and key phrases: crane parts, bucket and bag and jacket, dome and tent; a five-step process bar beneath all three.
mood: Calm and complete, the year folding into place.
pacing: Shelf one, shelf two, shelf three, process, each a few seconds.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and revise the second half of the year one shelf at a time.
